test_policy.notes: UC does not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or scholarships; UCLA does not ask for them in the application.

requirements.notes: Fee is $80 per campus, $95 for international applicants; fee waivers cover up to four campuses but only for U.S. citizens, permanent residents and AB540-eligible applicants. UCLA does not require or accept letters of recommendation and does not offer admission interviews. Some arts, music, nursing and theater/film majors require a supplemental application.

deadlines.label: UC application filing period closes
deadlines.note: Admission decisions released March 1-31, 2027 (some campuses earlier)
deadlines.notes: No early plans. Application opens August 1, 2026 for fall 2027. Self-report English test scores in the application; UCLA asks that they be reported by January.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if all or some secondary school was in a country where English was not the language of instruction and you have had less than 3 years of instruction in English. UCLA may also require its English-as-a-Second-Language Placement Exam after admission.

english.notes: UC minimum 80 (tests before Jan 2026). UCLA looks for competitive scores: above 100 with every section above 24.
UC minimum 4.5 (Jan 2026 or later). UCLA looks for 5 or higher with every section 5 or higher.

aid.notes: UCLA's admissions site says it does not award scholarships or financial aid to undergraduates who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents; admitted internationals must show funds (about $80,739 minimum for fall 2026 entrants). UCLA's financial aid site says internationals may be eligible only for outside scholarships, private loans and short-term loans.

majors.program: College of Letters and Science (first-year, incl. undeclared)
majors.notes: UCLA says that for College applicants the chosen major is not considered in admission review; changing majors within the College is not allowed during the application process, and about 1,500 students are undeclared at any time.

sat.note: UCLA is test-blind: SAT/ACT are not considered for admission or scholarships; codes apply only to scores sent after admission.

act.note: UCLA is test-blind; code applies only to scores sent after admission.

toefl.note: No undergraduate TOEFL code is published. Self-report scores in the UC application; UCLA says a TOEFL report sent to one UC campus reaches all campuses you apply to.

ielts.note: No code. UCLA says IELTS results must be sent to each campus you apply to; self-report in the application.

duolingo.note: No code. DET scores are sent through the DET portal with your UC Application ID, once per campus.

tier_notes.computer_science: Top-15 CS program in Samueli School of Engineering.
tier_notes.engineering: Samueli is a top-15 engineering school.
tier_notes.business: No undergraduate business major (Business Economics is an economics major; Anderson is graduate-only).
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Top-15 life sciences with a major medical center.
tier_notes.pre_med: Strong pre-med research opportunities through UCLA Health and the Geffen School of Medicine.
tier_notes.arts_design: School of Theater, Film & Television and School of the Arts & Architecture are among the leading US arts schools.
tier_notes.nursing: School of Nursing BS is a top-15 undergraduate nursing program.
